explanation: Shrunk scenario violates pole_upright at step 17 with theta -0.81 rad (limit 0.8). Trace shows monotonic divergence from initial theta 0.1: theta grows negative to -0.15 at step10, -0.48 at step14, -0.589 at step15, -0.698 at step16, -0.81 at step17, with omega accelerating to -5.7 rad/s. Sensor_noise 0.0081 corrupts angle measurement; with large dt 0.01987 (near 0.02 limit) controller samples stale noisy state once per outer step and applies incorrectly signed/magnitude force, failing to arrest fall despite force well below limit (0.15N vs 42.5N limit). Removing noise stabilizes.
vision_note: From steps 14 to 16 the pole tilts increasingly far from upright while the blue cart remains near center, with the orange tip showing the controller is active but failing to arrest the lean. At step 17 the tip turns red as the pole exceeds the upright threshold, visibly more inclined than in the prior frames indicating an accelerating fall.
